description:

Absolutely explosive! Score all six premium 1.5-gram THCA Bomber strains for just $35.99 and save 25% compared to buying individually! This stacked bundle includes: Cereal Milk, Grape Runtz, Jungle Juice, Platinum OG, Sour Tangie, and Sundae Driver. Detonate this deal before it's gone!

Details

• 
SIX 1.5g THCA premium hemp flower prerolls totaling 9 Grams

• 1 Cereal Milk (Hybrid)

• 1 Grape Runtz (Indica)

• 1 Jungle Juice (Sativa)

• 1 Platinum OG (Indica)

• 1 Sour Tangie (Sativa)

• 1 Sundae Driver (Hybrid)

• Wrapped in THCA Diamonds + CBG Kief

• 100% Hemp-Derived

Suggested Use

Ignite and inhale. If you're new to THC, try a few hits to see how you feel and dose accordingly from there for desired effect.

Cannabinoids

• THCA

• Delta-8 THC

• CBG

• CBD

What is THCA?

THCA Is The Precursor To THC

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 is made from pure CBD

 Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

What is CBG?

CBG AKA Mother Of All Cannabinoids

CBG (cannabigerol) the “Mother of All Cannabinoids” is a non-psychoactive and non-intoxicating derivative that breaks down to form other cannabinoids such as CBD and THC. CBG interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which regulates various physiological functions and possesses potential therapeutic benefits.

What is CBD?

CBD is Non-Psychoactive

CBD (Cannabidiol) is a naturally occurring compound found in the hemp plant that’s non-psychoactive. It has been shown to have a variety of potential health benefits, including relieving pain, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep.

THCP unforgettable high

Start low, go slow.

name: JOINTZ Hash Hole THCA Prerolls - Hybrid - 3 Gram - 3-Pack
description:
Description

JOINTZ Hash Holes are brought to you by the same legendary collaboration between Ocho Extracts, Trip Drip, and Sugar that gave you our famous BITEZ Gummies. We’ve taken that same commitment to elite potency and mouthwatering flavor and rolled it into the ultimate smoking experience. This 3-pack of hybrid 1-gram prerolls is designed for those who don't just want to smoke—they want to ascend.

Details

• 
Hybrid Strains: Watermelon OG, Unicorn Tears, Cherry Pie

• 
Format: 3-Pack of 1-Gram Prerolls (3 Grams Total)

• 
Core: Infused Hash Batter "Hash Hole"

• 
Flower: Premium THCA Hemp Flower

• 
Compliance: 100% Hemp-Derived, 2018 Farm Bill Compliant

Cannabinoids

• 
THCA

• 
Hash Batter Concentrate

What makes Jointz a triple threat?

Premium THCA flower meet an infused hash batter core for a heavy-hitting, full-spectrum high.

Each Jointz preroll is meticulously packed with top-shelf THCA hemp flower and features a concentrated hash batter "hole" in the center. This "hash hole" construction ensures a slow, even burn that produces massive, milky clouds and a potency that standard prerolls simply can’t touch.

Which strains are in the Hybrid 3-Pack?

Experience a curated rotation of Watermelon OG, Unicorn Tears, and Cherry Pie.

We’ve selected three of our most iconic hybrid profiles to ensure your session never gets stale. From fruity and refreshing to sweet and doughy, this pack offers a full terpene spectrum in one convenient grab-and-go container.

• 
Watermelon OG: A refreshing burst of sweet, juicy melon with a subtle kush finish—perfect for a balanced mid-day vibe.

• 
Unicorn Tears: An exotic, mysterious blend of sweet citrus and candy notes that provides an uplifting yet dreamy headspace.

• 
Cherry Pie: A classic dessert strain featuring the tartness of cherries and the richness of flaky pie crust for a cozy, relaxed feel.

Why is the "Hash Hole" a game changer?

The center-infused hash batter creates a "donut" burn that maximizes flavor and strength.

The hash hole isn't just for show—as the flower burns, the hash batter core melts into the embers, creating a hollow center (the "donut hole"). This allows for superior airflow and ensures you’re getting a potent dose of concentrate with every single pull, right down to the crutch.

How do I use Jointz?

Simply spark the tip, inhale, and let the hash batter core do the heavy lifting.

If you’re a seasoned pro, light up and enjoy the ride. If you’re new to the world of infused prerolls, start with a few hits and wait about 15 minutes to feel the full effects of the THCA and hash batter blend before diving back in.

What is THCA?

THCA is the natural precursor to THC that delivers the classic "high" when heated.

THCA is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in raw hemp, but once you apply a flame, it undergoes decarboxylation and converts into Delta-9 THC. This gives you a potent, authentic cannabis experience that is federally legal under the 2018 Farm Bill.

What is Hash Batter?

Hash batter is a high-potency concentrate that adds depth and "punch" to the flower.

By whipping hemp-derived extracts into a creamy, batter-like consistency, we create a concentrate that is rich in both cannabinoids and terpenes. Tucking this batter into the center of the joint elevates the potency to a "one-and-done" level for most smokers.

Full Panel COAs

[Watermelon OG COA] | [Unicorn Tears COA] | [Cherry Pie COA]

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.

description:
High-Potency, Precision-Dosed 1250mg Mushroom Tablets for Deep Exploration and Enhanced Perception.

Unbox your mind with our advanced Mushroom Tablet crafted for those who demand more from their entheogenic experiences, our 5000mg pack offers a sophisticated journey into heightened sensory awareness. Each 1250mg tablet is engineered to target specific neuro-receptors, facilitating a deep sense of euphoria, empathy, and vivid mental clarity.

Details

• 5000mg per pack | 1250mg per tablet

• 8 servings per pack (½ tablet = 625mg)

• Precise, fast-acting tablet format

• Supports deep, vivid, and prolonged experiences

How do I use Ms Mollie Cule Mega Dose Mushroom Tablets?

Proper dosage is essential for a safe and rewarding experience. Because these are "Mega Dose" tablets, we recommend the following protocol:

• 
Start Small: Begin with ½ of a tablet (625mg) to assess your individual tolerance.

• 
Wait and Evaluate: Effects can vary based on body size, metabolism, and recent food intake. Allow ample time for the onset before considering more.

• 
Go Slow: Always test new dosages at a slow pace until you are familiar with how your body interacts with the botanical compounds.

What should I expect from a 5000mg pack?

Our formula is designed to support vivid sensory enhancement and profound cognitive expansion. Users often report heightened visual clarity, deeper emotional resonance with music, and a sense of euphoric interconnectedness. This pack provides roughly 8 "micro-explorations" (at ½ tablet each) or 4 "deep-dive" sessions.

Are these "trippy" tablets?

While we avoid clinical labels, these tablets are formulated to support intense perceptual shifts and vivid neuro-sensory experiences. They target specific receptors to mimic the expansive feeling of traditional entheogens. If you are looking for a standard "functional" mushroom (like basic Lion's Mane), this product may be more potent than what you are looking for.

How long do the effects of the mushroom tablets last?

The duration can vary, but most users experience the peak of the journey within 1-2 hours of ingestion, with the total experience lasting between 4 to 6 hours. We recommend using them in a comfortable, familiar environment where you can relax and enjoy the shift in perspective.

Can I mix these with other supplements?

We recommend enjoying Ms Mollie Cule tablets on their own to fully appreciate the purity of the proprietary blend. Avoid mixing with alcohol or other potent stimulants to ensure the clearest and most stable experience.

description:
Description

Orange Soda THCA Prerolls

Experience the vibrant lift of our Orange Soda Sativa THCA Prerolls, each pack containing two 2G glass-tipped prerolls coated with THCA diamonds and CBG kief. Known for its refreshing citrus aroma and sweet, tangy flavor, Orange Soda energizes and enhances creativity. Perfect for daytime use or social gatherings, these prerolls deliver a smooth, exhilarating smoke with every puff.

Details

• Orange Soda (Sativa) Premium Hemp Flower

• 4 Grams (Two 2G Prerolls)

• Glass Tips

• Dipped in THCA Diamonds + CBG Kief

• 100% Hemp-Derived

Suggested Use

Ignite and inhale. If you're new to THC, try a few hits to see how you feel and dose accordingly from there for desired effect.

Cannabinoids

• THCA

• Delta-8 THC

• CBG

• CBD

What is THCA?

THCA Is The Precursor To THC

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 is made from pure CBD

 Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

What is CBG?

CBG AKA Mother Of All Cannabinoids

CBG (cannabigerol) the “Mother of All Cannabinoids” is a non-psychoactive and non-intoxicating derivative that breaks down to form other cannabinoids such as CBD and THC. CBG interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which regulates various physiological functions and possesses potential therapeutic benefits.

What is CBD?

CBD is Non-Psychoactive

CBD (Cannabidiol) is a naturally occurring compound found in the hemp plant that’s non-psychoactive. It has been shown to have a variety of potential health benefits, including relieving pain, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep.

CBG (cannabigerol) the “Mother of All Cannabinoids” is a non-psychoactive and non-intoxicating derivative that breaks down to form other cannabinoids such as CBD and THC. CBG interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system, which regulates various physiological functions and possesses potential therapeutic benefits.

What is CBD?

CBD is Non-Psychoactive

CBD (Cannabidiol) is a naturally occurring compound found in the hemp plant that’s non-psychoactive. It has been shown to have a variety of potential health benefits, including relieving pain, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep.
